description: OPENFRUIT Swift Macro & Compiler-Plugin Ecosystem 4-Stage Compatibility Inventory
completeness_claim: partial-catalogue; proof scope reviewed independently; not global compatibility

evaluation_stages.stage_1: Plugin Compilation for Windows host (can it be built natively as a .exe or .dll?)
evaluation_stages.stage_2: Plugin Loading (can swiftc load it via -load-plugin-executable, -plugin-path, or -in-process-plugin-server-path?)
evaluation_stages.stage_3: Macro Expansion (freestanding and attached AST syntax expansion)
evaluation_stages.stage_4: Cross-Target iOS Compatibility (does the expanded code compile against iPhoneOS.sdk with -target arm64-apple-ios?)
